event.description: Unclassified 35% solar array power drop with thermal anomaly in power conditioning unit

available_evidence.description: Raw current-voltage curves from all solar panel segments T-5s to T+30s
Attitude and control system log including sun-pointing error and slew history
Power conditioning unit thermal telemetry at 10Hz
Battery state-of-charge and discharge rate history from T-60s to T+60s
Communication link margin and signal quality log
Star tracker image frames for independent attitude verification
